CustomField.description: Street, city and country joined into one line for display. Exists because BillingAccount__c has no compound address field, and the Flow data table on the Quote "Link BAN" screen needs a single column. Blank components are skipped so no stray commas appear.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(BillingStreet__c), "", BillingStreet__c) & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(BillingStreet__c)), OR(NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCountry__c)))), ", ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(BillingCity__c), "", BillingCity__c) & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCountry__c))), ", ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(BillingCountry__c), "", BillingCountry__c)
CustomField.label: Billing Address
